fato_historico: 1792: In Washington, D.C., the cornerstone of the United States Executive Mansion (known as the White House since 1818) is laid.
energia_do_dia: Much like the laying of a grand executive cornerstone long ago, you may feel an urge to solidify your personal legacy. The cosmic energy invites you to place your focus on building lasting structures for your dreams. Consider this a golden opportunity to cement your ambitions with confidence and flair, honoring your inner royalty as you craft your future.
frase_do_dia: Great things are built when you place your dreams on a solid stone.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of shifting perspectives and new beginnings.
conselho: Lay your plans with courage and trust your innate sense of direction today.
